rules.accepted_credit_types: Board does not pre-approve programs or sponsors; programs must add to professional knowledge and competence, have significant intellectual or practical content and be germane to dental hygiene
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE does not apply until the licensee's first full year of licensure.
rules.carryover: Hours used to cure delinquent CE cannot be applied to the next reporting period.
rules.audit_note: Affirm CE duty at annual renewal; keep documentation (name, sponsor, title, dates, hours). Random audits by sampling.
rules.notes: Three-year CE cycles counted from 2015; licenses renew yearly by March 1. Current CPR, ACLS or PALS card required. Limited prescriptive authority: 3 h on fluoride, topical anesthetics or nonsystemic antimicrobials; limited access permit: +12 h.

topics.who: Current CPR, ACLS or PALS card
